messages.subject: Error: Failed to create the shared library.
parts:
I'm getting  Error: Failed to create the shared library under Sequoia 15.2 (24C101) and R 4.4.1 (details below)
I installed all the Xcode tools and tried:
install.packages("nimble")
which appears to succeed but give the above error under the nimbeMCMC example (which runs fine on a linux server).

I also tried
remotes::install_github("nimble-dev/nimble", ref = "master", subdir = "packages/nimble")
remotes::install_github("nimble-dev/nimble", ref = "devel", subdir = "packages/nimble")
which failed.

Did you re-install R after installing XCode and/or upgrading to Sequoia?
If that doesn't work, we'll ask one of our colleagues who has a new Mac to try the example.

-chris
